title: Irish Man Sabotaged U.S. Military Plane With Ax and Chemicals, Prosecutors Say
summary_full: Daithi O’Corrain sealed himself inside a National Guard C-130 at Ireland’s Shannon Airport in April for hours, causing so much damage that the aircraft was retired from service, prosecutors said.
